content:
maria: Quick sync — we need a one-pager + short launch post focused on enterprise customers evaluating secure/private deployments. Primary outcomes: webinar sign-ups, demo requests, and clear inbound routing.
aj: Ack. Target personas: platform leads, CISO, infra eng. Keep it exec-friendly + a bulleted tech ROI section.
liam: Suggested hero line: 'Run LLM inference where your data lives — enterprise SLAs, VPC & on‑prem options.' Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sophia: Love it. Can we call out explicit SLAs and fallback routing? security teams always ask about audit logs + KMS.
ev an: typo — that's "evan" :) Also suggest a 1‑liner about predictable unit costs, e.g., "Predictable latency and unit economics across deployment modes." short and measurable.
maria: Good. Structure proposal: 1) Problem statement (data locality, regs, cost uncertainty) 2) What Redwood provides (hosted/dedicated/private) 3) Key controls (SLA, KMS, audit logs, network isolation) 4) Performance & cost callouts (benchmarks + batching/quantization) 5) CTA: Webinar sign-up / Request demo / Download checklist.
aj: For benchmarks — include a micro-benchmark: 8k context, 50 concurrent QPS, p50 latency target < 200ms on Dedicated. We can say "typical" and link to full benchmark in the landing.
liam: For routing rules — propose explicit inbound rules we can hand to SDRs/AE triage:

- if industry in {finance, healthcare, gov} OR requires on‑prem => route -> enterprise-security queue
- if request mentions "pilot" or < 50k tokens/mo => route -> self-serve/onboarding
- if asks for SLA or dedicated capacity => route -> dedicated-sales

put that in a tiny code block on the doc? helps ops copy/paste.
sophia: Add compliance ask: if they mention FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI, tag as "compliance" and escalate to security-specialist AE.
ev an: I'll draft the copy for the hero + 3 bullets. Keeping micro copy for LinkedIn + blog snippet. Also will write short webinar blurb: "Secure LLM serving at scale — deploy modes, SLAs, and migration patterns." 30-min + live Q&A.
maria: Draft timeline: copy draft by EOD today, design by tomorrow, internal review Thurs, soft launch Friday to newsletter + LinkedIn. Webinar scheduled two weeks out. evan can you own landing + routing rules with ops?
ev an: Yep. I’ll make a short form for the landing that sets hidden fields: industry, company_size, compliance_flags. Routing pseudo-config I'll deliver as JSON to ops. Example:
```
{
  "industry": "finance",
  "compliance_flags": ["HIPAA"],
  "company_size": 2000,
  "route_to": "enterprise-security"
}
```
maria: Perfect. liam can you share the benchmark callouts and a screenshot of the perf graph? aj will get final legal copy for SLAs.
liam: On it — will export perf PNG + a tiny legend. Quick note: keep numeric claims conservative ("typical p50 < 200ms") and add a footnote for test config.
sophia: Design asks: 1 pager should have a one column PDF + one-slide social image. Use redwood visual palette, add a small "security & compliance" badge.
ev an: Uploading a rough draft to the channel now.
deploy-bot: Uploaded file "secure-deploy-onepager-draft-v1.pdf" (link: https://files.redwood.internal/secure-deploy-onepager-draft-v1.pdf)
maria: Thanks. I'll review and leave comments directly in the doc. Quick approval checklist: messaging alignment (ok), routing rules (ok), legal sign-off (pending). :thumbsup:
aj: I'll chase legal for SLA wording today.
liam: If we need a testimonial or partner quote, I can pull one from the pilot program — might help conversion.
sophia: Great. Final ask: include an FAQ box with 3 quick Qs: data residency, encryption at-rest/in-transit, rollback & fallback. Keep it scannable.
maria: Awesome team. Next update in this thread once copy+design are integrated. Assign follow-ups: evan (landing + routing) | liam (benchmarks + image) | aj (SLA legal) | sophia (design).
